# Security Requirements Checklist: S3-Compatible Local Storage Server

**Purpose**: Validate that security requirements (authentication, path safety, credential handling, management-plane security, network exposure, supply chain) are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable in the spec and contracts
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authentication & Authorization

- [x] CHK001 Are authentication requirements defined for ALL S3 data-plane operations (credentials + SigV4 by default, no operation bypassing auth)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Is the rejection behavior for missing/invalid signatures unambiguous — authentication error, no operation performed, standard S3 error codes (InvalidAccessKeyId / SignatureDoesNotMatch)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §US3-AS2]
- [x] CHK003 Is a signature timestamp/clock-skew tolerance window defined (or explicitly delegated to the protocol layer)? [Gap]
  > **Resolution (2026-08-22)**: delegated to the s3s protocol layer per AWS convention (±15 min) — spec §Assumptions/Authentication; actual window verified at implementation.
- [x] CHK004 Is the SigV2 capability requirement clear — off by default, documented as weaker, gateable via `[s3] sig_v2` consistent with the capability-gating mechanism? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, contracts/config.md §s3]
- [x] CHK005 Is anonymous mode consistently specified across all entry points — explicit flag/env only, overrides configured credentials with a warning logged, never silently enabled? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Is credential rotation behavior specified (config change + restart → only new credentials accepted)? [Completeness, Spec §US3-AS4]
- [x] CHK007 Is the generated-session-credentials behavior (no creds + no anonymous → generated, printed once) specified without ambiguity about when credentials persist vs. rotate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §Assumptions/Authentication]

## Path & Filesystem Security

- [x] CHK008 Is the path-traversal / absolute-path rejection requirement unambiguous — rejected outright, nothing outside the storage root ever read/written/deleted, zero filesystem side effects? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK009 Are the any-depth `.tinio` reserved-segment behaviors consistent across write (AccessDenied), read (NoSuchKey), and listing (skipped)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK010 Is the nested-storage-root isolation requirement explicit — an outer root must never serve an inner root's `.tinio/` (which holds credentials)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is the boundary between universal key rules (traversal, absolute paths, control characters) and platform charset rules (Windows-invalid characters) clearly drawn? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 Is the symlink policy requirement complete — followed by default, disableable, rejected + excluded from listings when disabled, out-of-root links documented as acceptable? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Are traversal attempts and invalid keys covered by automated verification requirements (SC-004's edge-case suite)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Credential & Secret Management

- [x] CHK014 Are sensitive-file permission requirements specified — config/state 0600, state dir 0700 on unix, ACL-restricted to the current user on Windows? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions/Environment]
- [x] CHK015 Is the read-only-mode home state dir (0700) and its credential-generation location specified without conflict with the root-config read rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK016 Is the management-plane token's generation, storage location, and protection clearly specified? [Clarity, contracts/management-api.md]
  > **Resolution (2026-08-22)**: token CSPRNG-generated ≥ 32 bytes, stored in `state` (0600/0700 or Windows ACL) — contracts/management-api.md.
- [x] CHK017 Is first-start credential generation ("auto-created config with generated credentials") vs. session-credential print-once behavior specified so credentials are never silently lost or silently exposed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK018 Is the exposure trade-off of passing credentials via CLI flags / environment variables (process listing, shell history, env leakage to child processes) documented as an assumption? [Assumption, Gap]
  > **Resolution (2026-08-22)**: documented as an accepted trade-off for a local single-user tool, with the config file (0600) recommended — spec §Assumptions/Authentication.
- [x] CHK019 Are credential/token redaction requirements defined for logs (access log, operational log)? [Gap]
  > **Resolution (2026-08-22)**: closed variable set cannot reference Authorization header / query strings / credentials — documented as a security property (spec §FR-017, contracts/config.md); no redaction required.

## Management Plane Security

- [x] CHK020 Is the token requirement specified for ALL management endpoints over TCP (including /metrics and /openapi.json)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, contracts/management-api.md]
- [x] CHK021 Is the local-channel auth matrix (unix socket / named pipe: token for /status and /stop, open /metrics and /openapi.json) defined and internally consistent? [Consistency, contracts/management-api.md]
- [x] CHK022 Are unix-socket permissions (0600) and named-pipe single-instance creation (FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE) specified? [Completeness, contracts/management-api.md]
- [x] CHK023 Is the HTTPS listener cert/key requirement unambiguous (PEM paths, missing → startup error, ports must differ between http/https)? [Clarity, contracts/config.md]
- [x] CHK024 Are single-instance semantics and stale socket/state reclaim specified so a crash recovery never weakens channel security? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Is the management plane's absence in `--no-default-features` builds specified consistently (CLI subcommands/options absent, `[api]` keys silently schema-known)? [Completeness, plan.md]

## Network & Transport Security

- [x] CHK026 Is the default loopback bind (127.0.0.1) specified as a deliberate security default and documented as a Minio deviation? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions/Network, contracts/minio-compat.md §6]
- [x] CHK027 Is the absence of TLS on the S3 data plane (v1) explicitly documented as an intentional exclusion rather than an omission? [Intentional Exclusion, Spec §Assumptions/Network]
- [x] CHK028 Is the absence of body-size and rate limits explicitly documented as an intentional choice for a local single-user tool? [Intentional Exclusion, Spec §Edge Cases, research.md §1]
- [x] CHK029 Are the combined implications of anonymous mode + non-loopback binding documented (explicit exposure, documented assumption)? [Coverage, Gap]
  > **Resolution (2026-08-22)**: layered trust model + graded startup warnings (basic non-loopback; prominent with anonymous) — spec §Assumptions/Network, §Edge Cases, contracts/cli.md.

## Supply Chain & Dependency Security

- [x] CHK030 Is dependency minimization enforced — every dependency justified in research.md §24 per constitution Principle I? [Completeness, research.md §24]
- [x] CHK031 Is `cargo audit` specified as a release/CI gate? [Completeness, Constitution §Rust Tooling]
- [x] CHK032 Is the unsafe-forbidding stance recorded, including s3s's `unsafe_code = "forbid"` as a selection rationale? [Dependency, research.md §1]
- [x] CHK033 Are dependency vulnerability/upgrade response requirements defined for the project? [Gap]
  > **Resolution (2026-08-22)**: constitution Rust Tooling — maintainer reviews `cargo audit` report before every release; vulnerable dependency blocks release unless risk documented and accepted.

## Security Failure & Boundary Scenarios

- [x] CHK034 Is observability of failed authentication attempts specified (request logging includes method/path/status per FR-017)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK035 Does the read-only-mode AccessDenied requirement consistently cover ALL mutating operation classes (bucket create/delete, object put/delete/copy, all multipart operations)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK036 Is the boundary between capability-disabled (NotImplemented) and security-denied (AccessDenied) responses clearly distinguished in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021 vs §FR-023]
- [x] CHK037 Are interrupted-upload / concurrent-write integrity requirements specified (no partial object visible as completed, last-write-wins) as part of data-safety requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK038 Is the zero-side-effect guarantee for rejected traversal requests (fail without touching the filesystem) objectively verifiable per SC-004? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, §SC-004]

## Cross-Domain Consistency

- [x] CHK039 Is the credential precedence (flags > env > .env > config) consistent across spec §FR-016, contracts/cli.md, and contracts/config.md? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK040 Are the read-only-mode config read rules (`.tinio.toml` wins, read-only, never written) consistent between §FR-023 and contracts/config.md? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK041 Does the spec distinguish "intentional security exclusions" from missing requirements — each exclusion carrying an explicit rationale tied to the usage model? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions, research.md §1]

## Notes
